add_archs: add new model architecture definitions to the global MODEL_ARCH registry dictionary
review_MODEL_ARCH: review the MODEL_ARCH dictionary containing default, xirb16d_dsmask, and mobilenet_v2 FBNet backbone configurations
review_MODEL_ARCH_CHAM: review the MODEL_ARCH_CHAM dictionary containing cham_v1a and cham_v2 CHAM backbone configurations
summarize_add_archs: summarize the add_archs function that merges architecture dicts into MODEL_ARCH with duplicate name checks
refactor_MODEL_ARCH: refactor the MODEL_ARCH default configuration to modify stage block types or channel widths
